candidates: app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:105 - `unsubscribe` crashes when the user has no TopicUser row.. `TopicUser.find_by` returns nil when the user has never had a topic_users row for this topic. That can happen when they got the email through a mention or a group notification without visiting the topic. `tu.notification_level` then raises NoMethodError, and the unsubscribe link returns a 500. Fix: handle the nil case, for example by calling `TopicUser.change(current_user.id, topic_id, notification_level: ...)`, which creates the row when it is missing. That call also publishes the MessageBus `notification_level_change` that a direct `save!` skips.

config/locales/server.en.yml:1852 - `unsubscribe_link` now needs `%{unsubscribe_url}`, but only notification emails pass it.. `Email::MessageBuilder` builds `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` for every email with `add_unsubscribe_link: true`. Before this change, the string only needed `user_preferences_url`, which the builder always sets. Now it also needs `unsubscribe_url`, and only `send_notification_email` passes that. Other emails that set `add_unsubscribe_link` (for example the digest) don't pass it. For them, I18n either raises `MissingInterpolationArgument` or leaves a literal `%{unsubscribe_url}` in the email, and the email also says "this particular topic" when there is no topic. The spec had to add `unsubscribe_url` to keep passing, which points to the same problem. I couldn't see the other callers to confirm which ones are affected. Fix: keep the per-topic sentence in a separate key and add it only when `unsubscribe_url` is present.

app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:98 - A GET request changes notification settings with no CSRF protection and no confirmation step.. Each GET to `/t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe` lowers the user's notification level: watching or tracking becomes regular, and regular becomes muted. This has several effects: - Any third-party page can embed `` and silently mute topics for a logged-in visitor. - Mail-client link scanners and prefetchers can trigger it before the user clicks. - Reloading the page, or a second visit, moves the level down another step, so watching ends up as muted. Fix: have the GET only render the page, and change the level through a POST or PUT with a CSRF token, or require a signed per-user token in the link.

app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:113 - Calling tu.save! directly skips the MessageBus notification_level_change publish.. `TopicUser.change` publishes `notification_level_change` on `/topic/:id` to the user. It also runs `observe_after_save_callbacks_for` (UserActionObserver). Writing `notification_level` and calling `save!` skips both, so the user's other open tabs or clients keep showing the old notification level. Fix: use `TopicUser.change(current_user.id, params[:topic_id], notification_level: new_level)`.
